plain.li: The {THING}. No.
I only turned my back for a moment.
That fire was too hot, I said so.
Don't anyone say a word about the {THING}.

warm.li: I'm sorry, everyone. There's bread, at least.

gloomy.li: Of course it burned. Of course it did.

cold.li: The {THING} is ruined. Serve the rest.

plain.li: Burned the {THING} for {GATHERING}. The whole table saw it come out.
{GATHERING}. The {THING} came off the fire black and I wanted the floor to open.
Spent the afternoon on the {THING} for {GATHERING}, and the last ten minutes ruined it.

warm.li: They laughed about the {THING} so I wouldn't feel bad. It helped a little.

blunt.li: Burned the feast. Next time I watch the fire.

gloomy.li: Everyone will remember {GATHERING} as the year I burned the {THING}.

cold.li: Fire too hot, dish left too long. A simple mistake.

plain.li: We kept {GATHERING} today. The first without {NAME}.
Somebody set out a cup for {NAME} at {GATHERING} without thinking. It stayed there all evening.
{GATHERING} again. Last year {NAME} sat on my left.
Went through {GATHERING} without {NAME}. I kept looking at the door.

warm.li: We said {NAME}'s name at the toast. It was the right thing to do.

gloomy.li: Every day we keep from now on will have {NAME} missing from it.

cold.li: Kept {GATHERING}. {NAME}'s place was empty. I noticed.

plain.li: The {GROUP} have gone. It ended badly, after all those evenings at their fire.
I liked the {GROUP}. I don't know how it went so wrong at the end.
The {GROUP} left without a word to me. I'd thought we were friends.

warm.li: I hope the {GROUP} don't think we're all like that.

gloomy.li: Make a friend, lose a friend. The {GROUP} are gone and it ended in shouting.

cold.li: The {GROUP} left on poor terms. So be it.

plain.li: We told {FACTION} we'd help, and we didn't. I was the one who promised.
Word came from {FACTION}. It's too late now.
Thinking about {FACTION}, and what they must be saying about us.

warm.li: I wish I could tell {FACTION} we really did mean to come.

gloomy.li: {FACTION} won't ask us again. I wouldn't.

cold.li: We failed {FACTION}. It will cost us with them.

plain.li: {SITUATION} is over, and we did nothing. I keep thinking about what we could have sent.
Travelers say {SITUATION} was bad. We sat here and watched it happen.
We had grain in the stores the whole time {SITUATION} went on.

warm.li: Next time someone out there needs help, I'm going to say so at the council.

blunt.li: We could have helped in {SITUATION}. We didn't.

gloomy.li: When it's our turn, who'll come for us? I wouldn't.

cold.li: {SITUATION} is over. The colony kept out of it. I'm not sure that was wise.

plain.li: [byother] Has {NAME} ever told you about {LABEL}?
[byother] Ask {NAME} about {LABEL} some time. Or I'll tell you now.
[byme] I'd better tell you about {LABEL} before {NAME} does.
[byme] You've heard about {LABEL}? No? Sit down.
You weren't there for {LABEL}, were you, {OTHER}?
So {NAME} and I, and {LABEL}. You have to hear this.

warm.li: I've been saving this one for you, {OTHER}: {LABEL}.

blunt.li: {LABEL}. You need to know about it.

cheerful.li: [byother] Oh, you've never heard about {LABEL}? It's the best one!

gloomy.li: You missed {LABEL}. You miss all the good ones.

plain.li: [byother] No. {NAME} didn't. Go on.
[byother] Wait until I see {NAME}.
[byme] You did not.
[byme] You never. Really?
I'll never look at {NAME} the same way.
Stop, my sides hurt.

gloomy.li: Why am I never there for these?
